syllabus_topics: Quality models. ISO 9001 quality management model. Quality audits. System certification. EFQM excellence model.
Statistical process control. Basic and advanced tools. Guidelines for improvement.
assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, evaluation is continuous, comprising group and/or individual assignments and two theory exams, each covering approximately half of the content. Class attendance and active participation will be valued. The final grade must be at least 5 out of 10 to pass the course. For the extraordinary call, a theoretical-practical exam accounts for 60% and previous individual/group assignments for 40%. For the early extraordinary call, a theoretical-practical exam accounts for 100% of the grade. For differentiated evaluation and Erasmus students, a theoretical-practical exam is 60% and individual/group assignments are 40%.
